rgc.geographical_location: Multiple locations (integrated public datasets) and synthetic data
rgc.paper: ProbCrack-Diff: A structure-aware probabilistic framework for concrete crack segmentation, quantification, and uncertainty estimation
rgc.note: RGC combines Crack 896 (1,946), CFD (118), Crack 500 (3,363), DeepCrack (521), DSCN (44), CrackCB (2,389), GAPs (509), DSC (990), Rissbilder (3,822), and 16,112 Pix2Pix-generated samples, for a total of 29,814 image–mask pairs. Users should review the original source datasets for applicable licenses and usage terms.
